```{r setup}
library(CBM4r)
```

Create the CBM4 virtual environment:

```{r virtualeenv_create}
cbm4_virtualenv_create("r-CBM4")
```

Use the CBM4 virtual environment:

```{r use_virtualeenv}
reticulate::use_virtualenv("r-CBM4")
```
